title: Alternating quantifier class
statement: Let $b$ be a Boolean value and let $i$ be a nonnegative integer. A language $L$ belongs to this class if there are nonnegative integers $C,c$ and a polynomial-time language $V$ such that, for every bit string $x$, membership $x\in L$ is equivalent to the alternating-quantifier predicate for $V$, with initial choice $b$, depth $i$, and quantifier-string length $C(|x|+1)^c$.
hypotheses_covered: there exist $C,c\in\mathbb N$ and a language $V$ in $P$
